title: Agent Passport rule pack, B2B payment initiation (APS 1001 revision 3, bank-first)
jurisdiction: United Kingdom (proposed industry standard; no current legal requirement)

policy.ceilings_note: Admission ceilings set by the bank when it admits an AI product to its list. Every customer mandate on that product must stay within them; the containment check runs when the customer signs.

pattern_threshold.note: the same rule refused this many times within the window on one passport raises an alert to the bank's payments risk team

chain_rules.title: Root mandate scope is well formed
Delegation is a subset of the root mandate
chain_rules.source: Delegation signed by the orchestrator key in agent_identity.cnf; beneficiaries, ceiling, actions, validity ⊆ root

chain_rules.title: Action lies inside the narrowest scope
chain_rules.source: Instruction signed by the delegated execution key named in the delegation

registration_rules.title: Accountable principal named, with a signed declaration
registration_rules.source: Filing declaration, as for a Companies House filing; accountability for the filing, not a quality judgement

registration_rules.title: Insurance evidenced, cover at or above the minimum, in force
registration_rules.source: Professional indemnity policy summary; minimum cover in the policy table

registration_rules.title: AI product documented with a pinned model version
registration_rules.source: Filing form: product name, identifier, release, foundation model provider and pinned version, documentation location

registration_rules.title: Independent Assurance Evidence attached and covering the registered use case
registration_rules.source: Independent benchmark or audit report: issuer, reference, date, use case, report location. Presence and scope are checked; the register makes no quality judgement

registration_rules.title: Product not already on the register

runtime_rules.title: Passport active and unexpired (bank's list lookup)
Agent identity signature genuine (customer key), bound to this admission
Instruction signed by the AI agent key inside agent_identity
Mandate signed by the customer and unexpired
Action permitted and payee account on the customer-signed allowlist
Amount plus 30-day total for this payee account within the monthly limit
runtime_rules.source: Mandate monthly_limit_per_account; bank-held ledger (limit in the mandate, total at the bank)

runtime_rules.title: Bank hold condition: amount above hold_above is held for the customer's named approver
runtime_rules.source: Admission condition set by the bank's payments risk officer
